rules.when: Trivial mechanical edit with an obvious path: rename, typo, formatting sweep, version bump, file gathering.
rules.why: Cheapest models with reliable tool calling; take whichever has quota.

rules.when: Large or risky but well-defined implementation: multi-file features, refactors, migrations where the path is clear.
Ambiguous or open-ended work: unclear requirements, design, investigation, root-cause analysis, with or without code.
rules.why: Strongest reasoning; delegate file gathering to cheap subagents.
